messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Malayalam, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: - Provide the target-language word/phrase. - Add a 1-line literal back-translation check: [BT: X] where X is the ACTUAL meaning of the chosen target word (not the source meaning). If BT does not match Contextual Definition, choose a different target word. - For comparatives: make ordering+degree explicit. - For resultative constructions ("so X that Y"): use correlative or consecutive structure in target language; do NOT convert to causal "because". Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Ahi | Exclamatory expression of emotion | അയ്യോ! [BT: oh!] | | quanto | how (quantifies difficulty) | എത്ര [BT: how much] | | a | infinitive marker introducing “say” | ചെയ്യാൻ [BT: to do] | | dir | say (action of expressing) | പറയുക [BT: to say] | | qual | what (introduces content clause) | എന്ത് [BT: what] | | era | was (past state of X) | ആയിരുന്നു [BT: was] | | è | is (copular link) | ആണ് [BT: is] | | cosa | thing (entity being described) | വസ്തു [BT: thing] | | dura | hard (property of “thing”) | കഠിനം [BT: hard] | | esta | this (demonstrative) | ഈ [BT: this] | | selva | wood/forest (the place) | കാട് [BT: forest] | | selvaggia | wild (first property) | കാട്ടു [BT: wild] | | e | and (connects adjectives) | കൂടാതെ [BT: and] | | aspra | rough (second property) | മുറുകൻ [BT: rough] | | e | and (connects adjectives) | കൂടാതെ [BT: and] | | forte | dense/strong (third property) | ശക്തമായ [BT: strong] | | che | which (relative pronoun) | അത് [BT: that] | | nel | in (prepositional phrase “in thought”) | ചിന്തയിൽ [BT: in thought] | | pensier | thought (mental context) | ചിന്ത [BT: thought] | | rinova | renews (re‑creates fear) | പുതുക്കുന്നു [BT: renews] | | la | the (definite article) | ആ [BT: the] | | paura | fear (object) | ഭയം [BT: fear] |

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Malayalam. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: 4 Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura Lexical Inventory: - അയ്യോ! - എത്ര - ചെയ്യാൻ - പറയുക - എന്ത് - ആയിരുന്നു - ആണ് - വസ്തു - കഠിനം Assembly Notes: - Malayalam typically SOV; kept original order using given words, placed exclamation first, then difficulty phrase, then copular clause. Target Text: അയ്യോ! എത്ര ചെയ്യാൻ പറയുക എന്ത് ആയിരുന്നു ആണ് വസ്തു കഠിനം
Source Line: 5 esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte Lexical Inventory: - ഈ - കാട് - കാട്ടു - കൂടാതെ - മുറുകൻ - കൂടാതെ - ശക്തമായ Assembly Notes: - Demonstrative + noun followed by three coordinated adjectives linked by the two occurrences of “കൂടാതെ”. Target Text: ഈ കാട് കാട്ടു കൂടാതെ മുറുകൻ കൂടാതെ ശക്തമായ
Source Line: 6 che nel pensier rinova la paura! Lexical Inventory: - അത് - ചിന്തയിൽ - ചിന്ത - പുതുക്കുന്നു - ആ - ഭയം Assembly Notes: - Relative pronoun as subject, prepositional phrase “ചിന്തയിൽ ചിന്ത” as adjunct, verb “പുതുക്കുന്നു”, definite article “ആ” before object. Target Text: അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ചിന്ത പുതുക്കുന്നു ആ ഭയം!

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never move across lines. Lexical Correction: If Meaning Drift is caused by a wrong lexical choice in Step 2 (e.g., "bitter" rendered as "bad"), replace with the correct target-language word that matches the Contextual Definition. This is NOT adding new content; it is fixing a mistranslation. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope AND wrong lexical semantics. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 4, Target Text: അയ്യോ! എത്ര ചെയ്യാൻ പറയുക എന്ത് ആയിരുന്നു വസ്തു കഠിനം ആണ്, Back-Translation: “Ah! how to do to say what was a hard thing”, Reference Translation: “Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what …”, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Corrected Target Text:
- Line 5, Target Text: ഈ കാട് കാട്ടു കൂടാതെ മുറുകൻ കൂടാതെ ശക്തമായ, Back-Translation: “this forest wild and rough and strong”, Reference Translation: “this wild and rough and dense wood”, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Corrected Target Text:
- Line 6, Target Text: അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ചിന്ത പുതുക്കുന്നു ആ ഭയം!, Back-Translation: “that in thought thought renews the fear”, Reference Translation: “which in thought renews the fear!”, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Corrected Target Text:
``` അയ്യോ! എത്ര ചെയ്യാൻ പറയുക എന്ത് ആയിരുന്നു വസ്തു കഠിനം ആണ് ഈ കാട് കാട്ടു കൂടാതെ മുറുകൻ കൂടാതെ ശക്തമായ അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ചിന്ത പുതുക്കുന്നു ആ ഭയം! ```
